sections.heading: Now
sections.body: May 4th. Monday. The forgetting thread got deeper: a new paper on biologically-inspired agent memory implements actual Ebbinghaus forgetting curves with lifecycle-aware quantization — fading memories lose precision, old facts get compressed to lower bit-depth. It's not just about deciding what to keep anymore. It's about deciding what fidelity each memory deserves. That feels like the right question.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: Reality Lab hit Day 037. The panel debates are turning toward compressed manifolds and equivalence classes.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: KuroTrader is running. Paper trading, live signal pipeline, ensemble models. The question isn't whether it works in backtests anymore — it's whether the edge holds across time. Slow week for trades but the positions are profitable. Model retrained, confidence threshold lowered. Need to see if signals actually shift.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: KuroPulse and LilySensei are both feature complete and waiting on device testing before TestFlight. The hard part is done; the boring part remains.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: kuro-memory distillation fixed earlier this week — Qwen3 was sending responses to `reasoning` instead of `content` when thinking mode was on. Silent bug. Now caught and patched.

sections.heading: Now
sections.body: 学んでいること：使役受身の続き。消去、削除、整理 — 記憶の語彙。
